meta.title: Projects — Aiken Tine Ahac
meta.description: Selected open-source libraries, developer tools, products, and experiments by Aiken Tine Ahac.

title: Projects.
intro: A selection of open-source libraries, products, and experiments I've built.

featured.title: Tools built for builders.
featured.description: Two open-source projects focused on making complex interfaces feel approachable: maps that compose naturally and data grids that work like users expect.

more.title: Products, packages, and experiments.
more.description: A wider selection of shipped ideas—from community products and playful web apps to Flutter packages and practical utilities.

frivsspr.title: FRI VSŠ Curriculum
frivsspr.description: A clearer, more approachable curriculum browser for higher vocational studies at the University of Ljubljana's Faculty of Computer and Information Science.

socialko.title: Socialko
socialko.description: An open-source social platform spanning a NestJS backend, Flutter applications, and React account-management tools, originally built as a graduation project.

hdwyg.title: HDWYG
hdwyg.description: How Deep Will You Go is a conversation game designed to move past small talk and create more meaningful connections.

routes.title: Google Maps Routes
routes.description: A Flutter package for drawing routes through multiple points on Google Maps using the Google Directions API.

app_tutorial.title: Flutter App Tutorial
app_tutorial.description: A package for building seamless, interactive onboarding flows that introduce users to an application's key features.

imageproc.title: Web Image Processor
imageproc.description: A focused browser-based utility for processing and transforming images without a heavyweight editing workflow.

mwh.title: Mess With Humanity
mwh.description: Create custom Cards Against Humanity-style decks, design question and answer cards, and export print-ready PDFs to play with friends.

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: A social reading experience for tracking books, reflecting on a reading journey, discovering titles, and connecting with other readers.

mapcn-rn.title: mapcn-react-native
mapcn-rn.description: Beautiful, accessible, and customizable map components for React Native. Built on MapLibre and Mapbox, styled with NativeWind or Uniwind, and installed with one command.
mapcn-rn.image_alt: mapcn-react-native preview showing three dark mobile map interfaces with routes, markers, and analytics

gigatable.title: Gigatable
gigatable.description: A source-installed React data grid for TanStack Table with editable cells, range selection, Excel-compatible copy and paste, fill handles, virtualization, and undo/redo.
gigatable.image_alt: Gigatable preview describing an Excel-like React data grid with a source-installed workflow
